63F Urinary incontinence 4 years ,RA on DMARD 25 years

September 14, 2023











 A 65 year old Hindu woman a housewife a resident of west bengal having a Bsc degree and belonging to middle class according to modified kuppuswamy scale presented to the general medicine OPD with 

chief complaints of 

-constipation since the past 3 years 

-continuous dribbling of urine since the past 4 years 

 History of presenting illness 

Patient was apparently asymptomatic 26 years ago , when she developed continuous dull aching pain in both the knee joints , which was exaggerated in the mornings and was bearable throughout the day , it was aggravated on walking and relieved on rest 

associated with redness around the knees

no history of trauma

no history of evening rise of temperature 

no history of cosmetic deformity(varicosity, skin discoloration)

-she underwent a bilateral knee replacement for knee stiffness 

-is on DMARDS since 25 years 

patient was incidentally diagnosed with hypertension 20 years ago during a follow up visit 

-she was started on antihypertensive medications

 patient complains of continuous dribbling of urine since 4 years 

it was insidious in onset with a few drops during the day and gradually progressed to continue throughout the day , urine is yellow in color and ammonical in odour 

patient reports recurrent UTIs where in she complains of 

-burning micturition

-pain before micturition and while micturition

-no history of hematuria 

-no history of frothy urine

patient also reports constipation since 3 years

she passes 1 bowel movement per 2-3 days , associated with pain 

patient passes flatus

not associated with blood 

not associated with abdominal distention

not associated with weight loss 

                                                            TIMELINE 




Past History -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

        known case of RA since 26 years on regular DMARDS 
        known case of HTN since 20 years on regular anti hypertensive medication
        n/k/c/o DM , TB , asthma 

       Surgical history
       -LSCS 35 years ago indication CPD 
       -B/L knee replacement 25 years ago 
       -n/h/o blood transfusions
      
       Treatment history        
      -DMARD 
      -anti HTN

Clonidipine 
Methotrexate 
Rabiprazole
Mirabegron
Nortryptylin
Folic acid



       
     Personal history 
    -Diet : mixed 
    -loss of appetite : since 3 years , feeling of fulless (due to constipation?)
    -bowel : constipation since 3 years , uses a laxative syrup 
    -bladder : urinary incontinence since 4 years with recurrent UTIs
    -no known addictions
    -no known allergies
     
     Family history 
   -mother had knee pain since she was 30 years old 
     
    Menstrual history 
   attained menarche at the age of 16 years
   regular cycles 5/30 
   pain during cycle , used 4-5 pads per day 
   
   Obstretic history 
  concieved spontaeneously 
  uneventful pregnancy 
  a healthy baby boy delievered at term by LSCS (due to CPD)

GENERAL EXAMINATION 
Serial progression of ?pyoderma 
  On 8th Feb 


        

17th Feb 


April 4

April 6 to April 9




17th April to 26th April 













May 1st to 14th may 















16th May to1st June.








26th june


Hip ulcer 26th June

INTRODUCTION  https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK538197/  Dandy-Walker malformation or syndrome is a rare congenital neurological anomaly that affects the development of the cerebellum, the region of the brain responsible for motor coordination and balance. This posterior fossa anomaly is characterized by agenesis or hypoplasia of the vermis and cystic enlargement of the fourth ventricle, causing upward displacement of the tentorium and torcula. Most patients have hydrocephalus at the time of diagnosis.
